name: 小鹬
evolution: 小鹬 → 鄙目鹬 Lv.16 → 高脚鹬 Lv.32 → 高帽鹬者
evolutionEn: Xiaoyu → Bimuyu Lv.16 → Gaojiaoyu Lv.32 → Gaomaoyuzhe
description: 小鹬有着灰白色的羽毛，孱弱的双翼还无法驾驭风的力量，但可以依靠尚为柔软的皮甲结构进行短暂的滑翔。虽然幼小却已经懂得在划过水面时溅起水花，吸引鱼虾露头，有时能收获比自己体型还大的战利品。
descriptionEn: Xiaoyu has gray-white feathers; its weak wings cannot yet wield the power of wind, but it can rely on its still-soft armor structure for brief gliding. Though young, it already knows to splash water while skimming the surface to attract fish and shrimp to surface, sometimes catching prey larger than itself.

skills.name: 鸣叫
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 激怒
skills.description: 敌方除本回合使用的技能，其他技能能耗+3，持续3回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy's skills other than the one used this turn gain energy cost +3, lasts 3 turns.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Damage reduction 70%, responding to an attack.

skills.name: 鹰爪
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 风隐
skills.description: 敌方和自己均脱离，先手-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Both enemy and self retreat, priority -1.

skills.name: 羽翼庇护
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击：自己获得连击数+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Damage reduction 70%; when responding to an attack: gains hits +2.

skills.name: 闪击
skills.description: 造成物伤，速度比敌方越高，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the higher your Speed compared to the enemy, the higher this skill's power.

skills.name: 锐利眼神
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains Defense and Magic Defense -120%.

skills.name: 扇风
skills.description: 造成物伤，若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if acting before the enemy, this skill's power +50%.

skills.name: 应激反应
skills.description: 自己回复25%生命，应对防御：改为回复50%生命。
skills.descriptionEn: Restores 25% HP; when responding to defense: becomes 50%.
